note: Bank of Guam's personal checking page: the Pacific Express account, opened online in the CNMI, carries a maintenance fee of 5 dollars a month, waived for customers 55 and older. Its other waiver needs e-Statements as well as an electronic monthly deposit, which the game doesn't track, so it isn't written; in-branch and paper statement charges aren't modelled.

sources.title: Bank of Guam, Personal Checking
sources.said: Available online only for Guam and the CNMI and in branch for all other regions. ... Maintenance fee of $5.00, waived if enrolled in e-Statements & electronic monthly deposit ... Customers 55 years and older have maintenance and paper statement fees waived
